subject.title: Include agent ID and task context in exec approval notifications

question: What authoritative task context, if any, should approval notifications expose across forwarded channels?
rationale: Agent identity is already authoritative, but cron names, session labels, caller-provided descriptions, and generated summaries have different privacy and spoofing properties; repository behavior does not establish which should become the approval contract.

options.title: Trusted metadata only
options.body: Show agent ID plus a sanitized existing cron name or session label when available, and omit Task otherwise.

options.title: Agent ID first
options.body: Make agent identity consistent now and track task-context semantics as a separate product decision.

options.title: Caller-provided task label
options.body: Add a new approval payload field supplied by callers, accepting the additional API surface and trust-validation requirements.

recommendation.title: Trusted metadata only
recommendation.body: Show agent ID plus a sanitized existing cron name or session label when available, and omit Task otherwise.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared approval-routing and rendering boundary appears to originate from and remain closely connected to this contributor's refactors.
